title: Prepare a merge request
summary: A merge request, or MR, proposes combining a source branch into a target branch. It connects code changes with review and pipeline results.
introduction: A merge request, or MR, proposes combining a source branch into a target branch. It connects code changes with review and pipeline results. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A merge request, or MR, proposes combining a source branch into a target branch. It connects code changes with review and pipeline results.

blocks.code:
Source branch: improve-empty-state
Target branch: main
Change: show No books found when search has no matches
Check: search for a title that is absent
blocks.title: Prepare a merge request

blocks.text: The source contains the proposed edit. The target receives it after the project's review and merge rules are satisfied.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write the visible before-and-after behaviour for this change.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A merge request can be a draft while work is unfinished; opening it does not merge it.
For more detail later, use this [GitLab further reading](https://docs.gitlab.com/tutorials/).
